records.title: Mantis: Mamba-native Tuning is Efficient for 3D Point Cloud Foundation Models
records.reason: arXiv abstract: PEFT adapts a 3D point-cloud foundation model, with training parameter count below 5%; it is a domain-specific training/storage adaptation and does not study LLM inference serving or runtime.

records.title: LaST-R1: Reinforcing Robotic Manipulation via Adaptive Physical Latent Reasoning
records.reason: arXiv abstract: proposes RL post-training for robotic manipulation and reports task success/convergence; no LLM inference compute, memory, latency, throughput, KV-cache, quantization, offload, or serving change is claimed.

records.title: The Consensus Trap: Rescuing Multi-Agent LLMs from Adversarial Majorities via Token-Level Collaboration
records.reason: The method interleaves agent token generation to resist adversarial-majority failures. The paper states its comparison uses the same decoding token budget as majority voting; its measured contribution is robustness, with no inference-cost, memory, latency, or throughput reduction. Token-level collaboration is not itself an efficiency improvement.

records.title: Relax: An Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning Engine for Omni-Modal Post-Training at Scale
records.reason: Relax separates RL rollout and training services; the reported 1.76×/2.00× throughput gains are RL training speedups with comparable reward convergence. It optimizes post-training pipeline throughput, not deployed LLM serving/inference.
